s.note: the rough little bar where the story starts
s.how: Score 600g pork rind, salt and dry uncovered overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling. Break up and dust with flaky salt mixed with chilli powder and lime zest.

s.note: the guitar case and the songs
s.how: Smash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, finely chopped white onion, a seeded green chilli, coriander and salt. Serve with warm corn chips.

m.note: the dusty Mexican town at night
m.how: Blitz 3 soaked dried chillies, 50g achiote, 200g pineapple and 2 tbsp vinegar and marinate 1.2kg sliced pork shoulder overnight. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then slice and crisp in a pan. Serve in 16 small tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.

w.how: Whisk 5 eggs with 200g sugar until thick and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Prick all over and pour over 395g condensed milk, 375ml evaporated milk and 125ml milk. Soak overnight and top with 300ml whipped cream and cinnamon.

d.how: Pour 30ml mezcal neat into each of four small glasses. Serve with orange wedges dusted in chilli salt. For anyone else, hand over a cold Mexican lager with lime.
